notes.title: It's Time for v 1.0
notes.content:
After launching the Early Access in late August last year, I’ve made a series of updates to achieve the initial development goals and address various issues based on community feedback, all without compromising the vision: creating a Deckbuilder where you can fully customize your cards. The game is now at a point where I feel it is ready for full release, so here we are.

[h2]What’s in this patch?[/h2]

This patch includes some small adjustments to the UI for widescreen compatibility and several bug fixes. Additionally, I’ve added a few new augments to enhance the defensive and offensive capabilities of certain elements (or lack thereof):

[b]Fire Wall (Fire)[/b]: Every Burn you apply also grants you the same amount of block.
[b]Fertilizer (Earth)[/b]: Turns your Regrow into Regrow+, which also increases your damage.
[b]Safe Guard (Lightning)[/b]: Every attack you make gives a random ally 4 block.
[b]Relentless (Dark)[/b]: Every time you attack, your damage increases by 2 (up to 100); resets when you kill an enemy.

[h2]Plans After Release[/h2]

Going forward, I’ll be focusing on getting the game ready for other platforms while keeping an eye on any bugs that arise. In the meantime, if any fun rune or augment ideas come up, I’ll be sure to add them in. Thank you for your support!

notes.title: v 0.95 Retribution Mode
notes.content:
Retribution Mode is now fully available. It introduces a slightly more challenging experience along with a leaderboard. Additionally, I've made several balance changes to Tier 4 runes to enhance their usability. Below are the details:

[h2]Retribution Mode[/h2]
This mode offers endless challenges with progressively stronger enemies. Each challenge presents three trials for selection:

[b]Trial of the Soldier[/b]: The easiest difficulty with the fewest steps.
[b]Trial of the Champion[/b]: A more challenging trial with one additional step and an extra elite term added to each battle.
[b]Trial of the Hero[/b]: The most difficult trial with two additional steps and both an extra elite and boss term added to each battle.
Harder trials provide greater rewards and higher leaderboard scores.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44441515/72365160b18a6d86ff644f187ed030532aa337fa.png[/img]

[h2]Balance Update[/h2]
[b]Suffer[/b]: Now lasts for 1 turn instead of triggering only once.
[b]Nurture[/b]: Now converts 150% of the target's Poison into Block, up from 100%.
[b]Surge[/b]: Now grants 20 Surge instead of 10 after defeating a unit.
[b]Cascade[/b]: Now grants 20 Cascade instead of 10 after defeating a unit.
[b]Refuel[/b]: Now grants 2 energy instead of 1 after defeating a unit.
[b]Drain[/b] and [b]Undermine[/b] now cost 0 energy, down from 1.

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Attacks no longer push enemies back in fast mode.
[*] Fixed a display issue where some cards are duplicated with certain runes.
[*] Fixed an issue where Vampire and Curse cause HP loss instead of restoration when used together.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing the Challenge menu from closing when the recruit menu appears at the start of a new run.
[*] Fixed an issue where sometimes the end game popup does not display after defeating the final boss in normal mode.
[/olist]

notes.title: v 0.94 Balance Update and New Languages
notes.content:
Most of last month was spent adding a few new languages to the game and ensuring all the text fits.. With most of the features completed, I've finally spent some time testing some weaker builds on the highest difficulty to ensure they are at least playable. Here are the details:

[h2]New Languages[/h2]

The game now supports Spanish, Russian, Korean, Japanese, France and German. Additionally, some English and Chinese texts have been reworded for better clarity (hopefully).

You can switch the language in the settings menu. 

[h2]Balance Update[/h2]

[b]Power[/b]: 
Your next attack deals 8/11/15/20 extra damage, stackable, remove after attack once.
[i][b]Power[/b] has been unplayable to say the least, even with the augment. In order to make power worthwhile throughout the game, I've now more than doubled the amount each one gives[/i]

[b]Smite[/b]:
You gain Power equal to 50% (75%) of the damage dealt.
[i][b]Smite[/b] is crucial for [b]Power[/b]'s sustainability, having it cost 1 energy is just too hard to use. So I've reduced its energy cost from 1 to 0[/i]

[b]Chill[/b]:
You deal 5/8/11/15 less {Damage}, stackable, halve.
[i][b]Frostbite[/b] itself is very difficult to execute due to enemy's high damage, especially in higher difficulties. That's where [b]Chill[/b] comes in, to make it more effective. I've greatly increased its strength[/i]

[b]Cold[/b]:
Deal damage to your target equal to 100(150)% of their Chill stack.
[i]As an alternate damage mechanic, [b]Cold[/b] is pretty hard to use due to its energy cost and the fact that [b]Chill[/b] is hard to stack. So I increased its strength from 50 to 100% and reduced its cost to 0.[/i]
With this change, the [b]Cold Snap[/b] augment now raises its effectiveness from 100 to 200%. 

[b]Sick[/b]:
Trigger target's Poison 1/2/2/3 time(s).
[i][b]Poison[/b] decays very slowly, so its strength can't be too high. To compensate, I've changed Sick to a tiered rune, it can now trigger Poison up to 3 times instead of just 1 time.[/i]

[b]Talents[/b]:
I've also updated a few champion's synergy runes to reflect the changes above.

[b]Unpredictable[/b]:
Changed how the randomize works, it now randomizes based on your champion's energy instead of your current progress. This affects both the term and Augment [b]Unpredictable[/b].

[b]Frost[/b]:
It now only triggers twice instead of three times.

[h2]New Achievements[/h2]

There is a new achievement called 'Lone Wolf' that triggers when you beat normal mode with only one champion. You can now set the champion limit to 1 in the difficulty settings, doing so will disable the tutorial automatically.

There are also three new achievements linked to the Retribution mode, you can access the mode in the "new_mode" branch if it's not released yet.

[h2]Other Updates[/h2]

[list]
[*] Significantly lowered the price of upgrading the tier of your card. You can now do it for free when the action gauge is full;
[*] When a champion is permanently dead, all its synergy runes are now also removed;
[*] When enemy or your card's damage is reduced to 0, it will now still trigger Frostbite;
[*] The refresh is now reset every time you complete 1 challenge instead of 3;
[*] Fixed an issue where terms wouldn't show up properly when there are more than 9 terms in a battle;
[*] Fixed an issue where the base runes weren't unlocked automatically on older saves.
[/list]

Thanks for your feedback!

notes.title: New Mode Test Invite
notes.content:
If you are interested in the upcoming new game mode, you can experience it early in the Betas branch. Find Rune Gate in the game library: Right-click -> Properties -> Betas tab, enter the code: [b]123456789012[/b] to unlock it, then switch to the new_mode branch.

After entering the game, restart your run or start a new game to choose the Retribution mode. This mode supports leaderboards and is relatively challenging. You can find specific information upon entering the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44441515/72365160b18a6d86ff644f187ed030532aa337fa.png[/img]

If you have any feedback, you can make a post in the community or let me know in [url=https://discord.gg/meSfrrUQ2x]Discord[/url]

FYI, Leaderboard is only active on Challenge difficulty.

notes.title: Patch Note v 0.932
notes.content:
This patch primarily focuses on runes and rewards:

1. Base runes can now drop in all battles. Previously, they were distributed across different realms (meaning you could only obtain the Spike rune in the Earth realm), making some of them difficult to acquire.
2. With the elemental pool now diluted by base runes, at least one elemental rune will drop in each row in the reward panel. (If you really want something specific to drop, use Focus.)
3. Removed XP, Coins, and Shards information from the event popup menu. (They are still rewarded post-battle, but not important enough to be displayed here.)
4. Reworked [b]Accelerate[/b]; it now allows you to draw more cards on the next turn.
5. [b]Radiant[/b] now also counts as attacks.
6. Battle information on the left side is now hidden by default (you can turn it on in the settings).
7. There is now an indicator on the top left showing when your cards won't gain more XP.
8. Fixed an issue where units sometimes get pushed back in fast mode.
9. Fixed an issue where typing in the search bar in the Forge can trigger keyboard shortcuts.

Thanks for the feedback!

notes.title: v 0.93 Disable Elements and Custom Portraits. Happy Holidays!
notes.content:
As the title suggests, this update addresses two key points based on your feedback. Let's get right into it:

[h2]Disable Elements[/h2]

Previously, there was no control on which types of elements appeared on the bridge. This resulted in receiving runes from elements that might not be needed. Now, you can disable up to three elements in the Signs menu. This prevents those elements from showing up on the bridge or in the recruit menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44441515/f2c717faf95a35de6655f854b9ff5b31a2fcbdce.png[/img]

[h2]Custom Portraits[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44441515/3c3cc63487617f13526ac281b710b14a6d063f6a.png[/img]

You now have the ability to set up custom portraits for in-game characters. Simply navigate to your game's local files in Steam (Right-click -> Manage -> Browse Local files). Locate the "Rune Gate_Data\Mod" folder and move the PNG files from Examples to the Textures folder to replace portraits in the game. Overwrite them with your preferred images, make sure that they are in PNG format and bear the same name.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44441515/480ad8cc1096cd0e8159d481abf196587b959230.png[/img]

[h2]Other Updates[/h2]

[list]
[*] Updated the visuals of a few pop-ups and tooltips to enhance readability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44441515/25ae966b946d1f06cab18bad44d0228f1b64086c.png[/img]

[*] Significantly lowered the crafting price of runes.
[*] Upgraded Infect to a tier 4 rune and buffed it a little bit.
[*] Addressed a few crash issues.
[/list]

As always, thanks for your feedback. Happy holidays!

notes.title: Patch Note v 0.922
notes.content:
As a damage mechanic, Elemental Illness has limited utility. It complicates the learning curve, adds unnecessary battle information, its runes lack practicality, and it restricts team composition. While the 50% extra damage is beneficial, it's seldom active, and, let's be honest, you don't really need the damage boost. And that's why I'm making the following changes:

1. Elemental Illness is now removed;
2. The concept of elemental damage has been eradicated to simplify the damage system, providing clarity and enhancing the adaptability of certain augments. Elemental attacks are now purely visual effects;
3. Secondary attributes of certain runes have been modified in the absence of Elemental Illness. All runes and augments directly tied to Illness have been removed;
4. Defense now decreases in tandem with armor endurance, and armor no longer possesses resistance;
5. Updated the recipes and tiers of most runes to ensure better balance and coherence in the game.
6. Base Elemental Attack Rune Rework:
[list]
[*] [b]Flame[/b]: Increased attack strength but reduces the block of all other cards when used (single turn).
[*] [b]Rupture[/b]: Now blocks instead of attacks. And it also reduces the block of all other cards when used (single turn).
[*] [b]Shock[/b]: Increased attack strength but reduces the attack strength of all other cards when used (single turn)
[*] [b]Iceblock[/b]:  Now blocks instead of attacks, and it reduces the attack strength of all other cards when used (single turn).
[*] [b]Guard[/b]:  Strength remains the same, but reduces the endurance of your armor by 1 when used.
[*] [b]Soulslash[/b]:  Increased attack strength, but reduces the endurance of your armor by 1 when used.
[*] [b]Cauterize[/b]:  Changed to deal 2x damage to block.
[*] [b]Peak[/b] (new):  Applies Jolt to the target when attacking
[/list]
7. All augments triggered by elemental damage are now triggered by all damage. [b]Flame Strike[/b] has been reworked:
[b]Flame Strike[/b]: Changed from increasing fire damage to increasing lost health.
8. [b]Dubious[/b]'s damage per turn is now halved;
9. All relevant tutorials have either been removed or updated.
10. Fixed an issue where some buffs increased your damage in the preview, but the actual damage did not increase when you played the card.

Thanks for your feedback!

notes.title: v 0.92 Rare Runes and Mixed Runes
notes.content:
This update addresses a lot of issues around runes. I've made a few changes to the existing system, and added a few new things that hopefully makes this game more enjoyable. Here are the changes:

[h2]Rare Runes[/h2]

One of the issues with runes is that they are just puzzle pieces to your overall strategy... useful, but not that "exciting". Rare Runes are hopefully the solution to this problem, they are the OP version of the normal runes that can boost your strength significantly, and as their name suggests, they have a relatively rare chance to spawn. The only way to get them is through battles and encounters, you can dismantle the ones you don't want, but you can never craft them.
That being said, I don't want to make the tiered runes (Attack I, Poison I.. etc) completely obsolete, so the rare version of those runes are around the strength of a tier 3 normal version. Which means the tier 4 version of poison (Poison IV) would still be stronger than the rare version of poison (Poison+).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44441515/2500788b360408c89b7af907eb7a8a2dd9c12a74.png[/img]

[h2]Mixed Runes[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44441515/942a296a418dbf838cc3afc16da71e7f5f13ead0.png[/img]
Mixed Runes are dual-elemental runes that can only be crafted in the forge. They are the "mixed" version from the runes they are crafted from, which can be really strong, and potentially game breaking. There are six new mixed runes at the moment, along with [b]Amplify[/b] and [b]Invigorate[/b].

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]

1. All the base runes are now unlocked by default to give players more choices in the early game.
2. Runes are now spread out evenly in the realms menu. The ones that are already unlocked are now removed. Tier 4 runes can now be unlocked and crafted.
3. As a result of change 1, all champions now unlock three elemental runes on recruitment.
4. Tiered runes will appear more often as a reward post battle.
5. Added two new weapon runes:
[list]
[*][b]Taunt[/b]: Make the target enemy attack you if possible.
[*][b]Ease[/b]: One of the cards in your hand will cost 0 during this battle.
[/list]
6. Added an Assist Rune tab in the Rune Panel.
7. Removed runes that are uncraftable from the forge.
8. Tweaked [b]Purify[/b] and [b]Nurture[/b] so that they are relatively more balanced.
9. Fixed an issue where crafting some runes in the Signs menu doesn't visually increase the count.
10. Fixed an issue where card upgrades can be clicked multiple times in a row.

These are all the changes, some of the rare runes may be too strong or not strong enough. I'll make adjustments if necessary in the future.

notes.title: Patch Note v 0.913 Boss & Elite Terms.
notes.content:
This patch added a few changes and terms to boss & elites fights to make them more challenging and unique. Also a few other changes:

1. 10 new boss & elite terms are now added. Boss fights have one boss term and one elite term, elite fights have one elite term. Reinforcement and Tier are now part of the elite term.
2. Tweaked the moves of bosses in wave 3 and 4;
3. Now that terms offer enough rewards for you to upgrade and remove your cards, I've now made the following change to the card system:
[list]
[*] [b]Upgrade [/b]can now increase the tier of your cards if you equip a higher tier weapon;
[*] You'll now only able to use [b]Transform[/b] to upgrade the rarity of your cards instead of tiers;
[*] [b]Remove[/b] is no longer linked to your weapon, remove cost will now only reset after each boss battle;
[*] More information is given in the upgrade and remove popup menu.
[/list]
4. Some units will now speak during the tutorial and boss battles.
5. "Moves" are now called "Cards" to avoid confusion.
6. [b]Consume[/b] Rune no longer gives you block.
7. Fixed an issue where sometimes your units' turn will be automatically skipped.
8. Fixed an issue where assists targets does not match your current unit.

The rune system still has a lot to improve, in terms of the runes you get after battle, the runes that are unlocked in the start and the quality and quantity of runes overall.  I'll be focusing on addressing these next. Thanks for the feedback!

notes.title: v 0.91 Battle Terms and Enemy Phase Shifts
notes.content:
This update contains three major changes, along with 4 new runes and a few balance tweaks and bug fixes.

[h2]Battle Terms[/h2]

[b]Battle Terms[/b] are unique challenges within each battle, they each offer a reward once the battle is finished, and different elemental realms have their own set of terms. More Terms will be applied to battle as the wave progresses in order to offer a higher challenge, and elite battles have more terms than normal battles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44441515/accf7170687b98952a0f803dbe303c2f70ea5f8c.png[/img]

Each battle also contains an empty slot for you to apply a term of your choosing if that's what you desire. If you lack resources to upgrade or remove a card from your deck, you can pick a term that contains the target reward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44441515/98fc4983f38e51defd4a1476ddebde1af913e89e.png[/img]

[b]Reinforcements[/b] are also now part of terms with its condition changed. Instead of counting down when each unit ends their turn, now it counts up when you end all your units' turn, with an incentive to finish the battle as fast as possible:
"Finish the battle in 4 turns to receive rewards or face enemy reinforcements."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44441515/00eb9d513459279a40af2385f548cb086c1d712b.png[/img]

[h2]Phase Shift[/h2]

Elite units and certain units on later waves have more than one phase, their move sets will change once their HP drops to a certain level. After this update, a block move will also be triggered once their phase shifts and a certain effect will also be applied to the enemy. The elemental type of the enemy will determine what actual effect is applied.

A visual effect is applied in order to make the phase shift more obvious, and phase HP info is added in the unit tooltip so that you can plan for the shift in advance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44441515/0a400e481c4294348c1fe5c054914abec43e8838.png[/img]

[h2]Cards Now Come With Runes[/h2]

When you pick a card reward for your weapon post battle, there is now also a rune attached to each card as well. The rune can be outside of your rune pool, hopefully, this can make the card choice more impactful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44441515/65b74ecdf66c8938a9e36c5f33bec24b8f9dc8b8.png[/img]

[h2]New and Updated Runes[/h2]

4 new runes are now added:

[b]Explode[/b]: Deal 100/200/300/400 Fire Damage to you and all enemies after 3 turns
[b]Conduit[/b]: Deal 5/7/9/11 Lightning Damage to a random enemy within range when attacked
[b]Flash[/b]: Apply 35% Blind to your attackers.
[b]Deplete[/b]: Apply 20% Weak to your attackers

The normal [b]Energize[/b] is pretty counter-intuitive to use. It gives you 1 energy but also costs 1 energy to use. It's only useful on multi attacks/blocks, which is not useful at all. So instead of raising its cost, it now has a "Bargain" effect, but it can only trigger once per card.

[b]Energize[/b]: You gain 1 Energy, Decrease this move's damage or block by 8.

In order to differentiate special Energize from normal ones, they can now be applied to target:

[b]Energize (Special)[/b]: Target gains 1 Energy.
[b]Energize (Assist)[/b]: Target gains 1 Energy.

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
1. Enemy units' attack and block values are now tuned down a bit to make it less punishing on higher difficulties;
2. Changed Buff and Debuff's trigger VFXs to make it less chaotic;
3. Updated the visual of the battle popup menu;
4. Your Energy can no longer be negative;
5. You can now see all your units' Augments in the merchant menu;
6. Fixed a few bugs.

notes.title: Patch Note v 0.901
Patch Note v 0.90 New Runes and Augments
notes.content:
This update adds 20 new Augments and 10 new Runes, along with a few reworks and a new dodge mechanic.
The main purpose for this update is to encourage different play styles for each element.
Here are the changes:

[h2]Lightning[/h2]

Reworked Current, to add a new way to deal damage but also consistent with the theme of lightning runes:
[b]Current[/b]- Deal x Lightning Damage to a neighbor when you are attacked, and to you if none exists, stackable

To make Current more useable, the following lightning runes are reworked and added them back to the pool:

[b]Jolt[/b] - Receive x extra damage, stackable, halve after the end of the turn
[b]Jump Start[/b] - Trigger Current 2 times.
[b]Trigger[/b] - Apply X Current to target, X is 50% of target's Jolt count

In the meantime, adding following Augments:
[b]Flow[/b] - Every 3rd attack move you use also applies 4 Current
[b]Pressure[/b] - JumpStart triggers Current 2 more times.
[b]Attract[/b] - Your attacks apply Aggro to your target

Since automatically applying Static to enemy units is not that useful, Static Shock is now reworked
[b]Static Shock[/b] - Your Lightning Damage has 20% chance to apply 4 Current

[h2]Earth[/h2]

In order to make Poison and Spike more viable, adding following runes:

[b]Sick[/b] - Trigger target's Poison once.
[b]Release[/b] - Deal 2X Earth Damage to a random target, X is your Spike count, halve your Spike

And a new rune within the dodge system:
[b]Evade[/b] - Dodge your next incoming attack this turn.

New Augments:
[b]Viper[/b] - For Every Point of Poison the target has, raise your Attack Damage by 2%, can not by higher than 100% 
[b]Hex[/b] - For Every 3rd attack played, apply X poison to target, X is your Regrow Count.
[b]Elusive[/b] - Your Evade Rune can evade one more attack.
[b]Reserve[/b] - Release no longer reduce your Spike.

[h2]Ice[/h2]

Frostbite is triggered after attack, which is not quite useful in the late game when enemies have high damage.
So I reworked Chill and Cold and added them back into the game, to add a new way to reduce and deal damage.

[b]Chill[/b] - Target deals x less damage, stackable, halve
[b]Cold[/b] - Deal X Ice Damage to target, X is 50% of target's Chill

New Augments:

[b]Hard Bite[/b] - For every 3 attack moves played, deal 100% of target's Frostbite as Ice Damage.
[b]Cold Snap[/b] - Your Cold Runes now deals 100% of target's Chill as Ice Damage.
[b]Stone Cold[/b] - Whenever you are attacked, apply 3 Chill to your Attacker
[b]Chiller[/b] - Every time you apply Frostbite, also apply 1 Chill.

[h2]Fire[/h2]

Fire runes are generally high risk and high damage, that's why I reworked Fury and Offer:
[b]Fury[/b] - Deal and receive X extra damage, stackable, halve.
[b]Offer[/b] - Receive 10 Fire Damage, gain 2 energy.

New Augment:
Lunatic - When you have Frenzy Active, gain 4 Fury at the start of every turn

[h2]Light[/h2]

2 new runes are added within the dodge system:
[b]Dodge[/b] - You have 30% chance to dodge your incoming attacks.
[b]Blind[/b] - Target attacks have a 30% chance to miss this turn.

Power and Radiant are relatively weaker compared to other elements, the following augments are added to change that:

Power Play - Your Power can now deal one more attack before removed.
[b]Judge[/b] - When you have Power active, your attack targets receive X Suppress, X is 20% of your attack damage.
[b]Oppressor[/b] - When your attack target has 0 blocks, deal X extra damage, X is 50% of target's Suppress count.
[b]Luminous[/b] - Radiant can damage one more target.

Some augments are now useless after a list of updates, they are now reworked:

[b]Clear of Mind[/b] - Your Purify and Bless now removes 1 more effect.
[b]Benediction[/b] - Your Ward, Fortify, Aegis lasts one more turn.

[h2]Dark[/h2]

To make HP change a more useful mean to attack, the following runes are added and reworked:

[b]Curse[/b] - Target Lose x HP for every debuff it has
[b]Destroy[/b] - Target lose 10% of its current HP

In order to make Rend more stackable, the following Augments are added:

[b]Corruptor[/b] - When you have Corrupt active, every time you attack, apply 5 Rend
[b]Conjure[/b] - Increase 5% Attack damage for every Debuff the target has.
[b]Slicer[/b] - If target has no armor, you apply 2 extra Rend
[b]Dark Knight[/b] - Your attacks apply 1 Rend for every debuff the target has.

These are the core changes of this update. I've also adjusted a few Synergy Runes and fixed a few bugs. I'll be mostly focusing on updating enemy units next and fixing any bugs that come up in the following days.

notes.title: Patch Note v 0.891
Patch Note v 0.89 Adding Synergy Runes. Major changes to Cards and Runes.
notes.content:
This is a fairly big update. The goal of this update is to improve the experience of early to mid game, make each weapon more unique and adjust the balance of certain runes.

[h2]Synergy Runes, and Changes to the Talent System[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44441515/0b18280671aa00c1856969ad3443ca79302d5226.png[/img]

Synergy Runes can be gained after you upgrade your character, they can only be equipped by your teammates. They are a bit over-tuned due to their rarity. They serve two main purpose: 1. Improve interactions between characters; 2. make certain builds more viable in the early game.

In addition, all its runes will be unlocked after you recruit a champion from now on, so that you can have more runes to choose from in the early game.

[h2]Changes to the Weapon Moves[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44441515/4c38c39e8434d827f4cbb11e64afb2124a6cef51.png[/img]

In order to make each weapon more unique, I've made certain changes to Sword, Bow and Staff cards. You can check them out in the Compendium Menu:

Sword - Attack type weapon, with a strong focus on areal attacks.
Bow - Attack type weapon, with a focus on single target and piercing attacks.
Staff - Assist type weapon, its attack/block values are low but can affect more targets.
Shield - Defense type weapon, with a strong focus on blocks.

[h2]Changes to Runes[/h2]

Before this update, in order to have a sense of progression, all runes have 4 levels. But this has caused three major issues:
1. Some runes are just not suited to have 4 levels. In order to make each level meaningful, they are either too weak in the early game or too strong in the late game, or both. They are extremely hard / impossible to balance.
2. You can't get enough runes to upgrade them to level 4. To compensate, I had to give tier 3 runes after Wave 2, which kind of making the level system meaningless.
3. Due to issue 2, the runes you get in the early game are just placeholders to be replaced, which makes getting new runes not that exciting and affects the early game experience.

That's why I made the following changes:
1. Half of the runes no longer have levels. They will now only have "1 level" (1 effect), which can be used from start to finish. This change will certainly make the early game easier and late harder, which is a good thing considering the game difficulty at the moment;
2. Since some runes still have levels, in order to make them more meaningful, now the game will only give you level 1 runes (with a small chance to get level 2s). 
3. Runes are now separated into normal and rare category, they have a slightly different background. Rare runes can be gained in the elite battles and have a chance to appear after normal battles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44441515/f9dccb008e10284cadb633fa041ba54a8d3382bd.png[/img]

Other Changes:
1. Saves now have a date displayed;
2. Added a Compendium Menu, you can check all the cards and augments in there;
3. Added Assist Runes that let your teammate play a card free of cost.
4. Fixed a few bugs.

Thanks for the feedback!

notes.title: Patch Note v 0.881
Patch Note v 0.88 Extra Difficulty Settings. Switch Between Units in Battle.
notes.content:
This was originally planned as the second milestone. I wasn't gonna make this change until I made a few more changes to the gameplay. But since a lot of feedback involves around difficulty, starting weapon and game length, it seems important to move this update ahead. Now, let's talk about the changes.

[b]New Difficulty Settings[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44441515/f47ed91fb4d29acc0ec47c2076af04b3554a2738.png[/img]

1. [b]Starting Weapon[/b]: A lot of people want to setup the MC's starting weapon, so I added this option. Also, people have mentioned the fact that the MC can use all weapons and runes is a bit OP, so I added an option to lock the MC to its starting weapon type.

2. [b]Game Length[/b]: The original length was 69 days, which is a bit too long for some players. So I added two more shorter options. Please bear in mind that making the game shorter will also make it harder, as you will be facing stronger enemies sooner.

3. [b]Champion Limit[/b]: Some of you want to recruit more champions. You can now do so if you wish.

4. [b]No Potions and Extra Health[/b]: The original game has no potions and its champions have no extra health, but it turns out to be too punishing for some players. Now you can experience what they've experienced, if you so wish.

5. [b]Permanent Death[/b]: Why not.

6. [b]Endless Mode[/b]: it used to turn on by default in the hard difficulty, now it's up to you.

Hopefully you can find the right difficulty and tempo in these options.

[h2]Switch Between Units in Battle[/h2]

After the turn mechanic change, speed and turn order are not as important as it used to be. It makes more sense to give the player the freedom to choose whoever they want to go first. That's why I made this change.

You can now switch actively units by clicking on their portraits, and picking "End Turn" will jump to the next available unit, until there are none. 

In order to maintain the coherence of the gameplay, once a character has played a card, you can't switch anymore until you end its turn.

[h2]Stage Progression[/h2]

Some players mentioned they don't know when the boss will show up and how long each stage is. Now that the game length can be different, this information has become more relevant. 

You can now see the entire stage on the top left of the main menu. I also renamed "Stage" to "Wave" as it makes more sense in the context of defending the bridge.

Other changes:
1. Made a visual change to the top menu. 
2. Offer now applies to yourself even if you put it on an attack card. 
3. Fixed the tooltips of some gears and units.
4. Leora and Notus can now use default rune they unlocked.
5. Fixed an issue where some buffs and debuffs displayed wrong info.

Since this is a fairly big change, it might introduce a few new bugs. I'll fix them as soon as I find them.
I'll be focusing on adding/changing/improving Runes, Augments and Moves for the next two weeks.

notes.title: Patch Note v.0863
Patch Note v.0861 - 2
Patch Note v.086 Weapon System Rework
notes.content:
Weapon System has been in a lot of players' feedback, for three reasons:

1. When you invested a lot in a weapon, you don't want to change it, even if it has a "higher quality";
2. It's very tedious to change weapons, even though you can unload all runes at once, but you still need to equip it one by one;
3. At the end of the battle, you not only need to claim 3 runes, you also need to upgrade the weapon of every character, it's just too much things to do.

That's why I made the following changes:
1. Moves will no longer bind to Weapons, they will be linked to your Champions from now on. Weapons still exist, but they only serve two functions:  1. Provide you new moves (same algorithm as before); 2. Gives you higher tier Moves after you switch to a higher tier weapon. I believe this change would make new weapons more usable while maintaining reasonable deck growth. And you no longer need to swap out all your moves.
[i]Even though the old system gave players more choices at early game, but the core of "deckbuilding" is to build your deck step by step, instead of swap the whole thing out in one go.[/i]
2. Now you can only pick one character to get a new move, instead of all. As a compensate, I'm introducing a "Transform" system, you can now transform your moves into a random move of the same or higher quality. Transform will also be free when you can upgrade your move for free.
[i]The purpose of this change is to reduce the choices you have to make post battle. Although it affects your deckbuilding to a certain extent, but I believe "Transform" will help alleviate that a little bit. After all, the core of the game is rune customization. [/i]
3. Limiting the move upgrade count to 6. In the meantime, the naming convention for your Moves are now changed: your Move's upgrade count is no longer a Roman Numeral, instead, it will show as a progress on the left side of the card. Strike I and Strike II now means they are of a different tier (Tier C Weapons give Strike I, Tier B Weapons give Strike II).
[i]The purpose of this change is to make moves more intuitive, and higher quality moves more useful and attractive. [/i]

Along with a QoL change: You can now dismantle or switch the gear you get post combat in the result screen. 

Other changes are as follows:
1. The Essence you get for dismantling runes are reduced by halve. The purpose of this system is to remove the runes you don't want, instead of changing all runes to the ones you want;
2. Reinforcements and Strong Foe will wait for 1 turn when they entered the battle field, to give you time to react;
3. Augment "Summoner" will now only draw 1 card (too OP).

Fixed a few typos, display issue and crashes.

Thanks for your feedbacks!

notes.title: Patch Note v.0841
Early Access Plans
notes.content:
Here are the development plans from early access to full release.

First, these are the high priority items that will cover the entire development process:
1. Any bugs that will affect or block your gameplay experience, I'll fix them asap;
2. New mechanics or mechanic changes that will improve the overall gameplay experience;
3. New Runes, Augments or Moves that I think would be fun to add;
4. QoL interface improvements

[h2]Milestone 1 - Improving Bosses, and Enemies[/h2]
[i]Estimate: 1-2 months[/i]

Even though right now each boss has their own skills and move sets, I'm still not quite satisfied with it. Their skills is a bit too random and their mechanics can be more fun. My goal is to make each of them unique in their own way. (At least for unique that realm). And each realm's enemies can have a bit more skill variants other than buffs and debuffs. These will be what I intent to improve in the following month.

[h2]Milestone 2 - New Difficulty[/h2]
[i]Estimate: 1-2 months[/i]

Not just improving enemies' Health and Strength, this mode will include: No Potions, Less HP, Hardcore Mode, and possibly a leaderboard that only exists in this mode. Also I'm thinking about only allowing 4 units in this mode, and whether or not to increase card's rune slot to 5 (only in this mode).

Depending on how easy hard difficulty really is, I might move this milestone forward.

[h2]Milestone 3 - A New Game Mode[/h2]
[i]Estimate: 2-3 months[/i]

I already have a few ideas, but I'm not ready to say anything until they are finalized.

Once the three milestones have completed, I'll switch the game to full release.

notes.title: “Rune Gate” Early Access is now released!
notes.content:
[h1]Full Version Change Log: [/h1]

Thanks for everyone's feedback during these time, it made me realize that a lot of designs in the game still have some flaws. The following changes are my attempts at refining the overall gameplay experience:

[h2]1. Simplifying Defense and Illness System[/h2]
Removed layers from the Defense system, now Defense will drop to 0 when you clear target's Endurance, plain and simple;
Removed the tier mechanic from the Illness System, now Illness only has two states, active and inactive, when it's active, the target will receive extra elemental damage, resets after two turns.
The previous system is overcomplicated for so obvious reasons, it makes sense to remove them.

The tutorials are updated accordingly, Illness currently are still using the old icons, I'll figure out some ways to make them easier to understand.

[h2]2. Early game improvement and QoL[/h2]
1. You no longer need to "Confirm" to equip Runes, you can directly switch to the next Skill and keep going if that's what you want. 
[i]Hopefully this will greatly reduce the times you need to click on the menu[/i]
2. The enemy units in the first stage are now closer together, making it easier for you to aoe them
[i]Even though I introduced runes to move units to solve the issue, but the overall experience are still pretty bad, so I changed it.[/i]

[h2]3. The main characters can now equip all weapons[/h2]
The default weapon is still sword, but you can wear anything after the update, it makes the formation... more flexible.

[h2]4. Tutorials[/h2]

The mechanics in the game are now more spread out, elemental illness are now introduced in day 4, the forge is moved to day 6, and the follower will be introduced in day 7, you'll no longer get any elemental runes before day 3, and you won't get any followers before day 7. (And the follower slot won't show up till day 7), The Realm's tutorials are not split into 2 and no longer a popup.
[i]Note: These changes won't effect returning players, or players on new runs.[/i]

[h1]New Runes[/h1]

1. [b]Wound[/b] is now reworked since it's too similar to [b]Poison[/b]. It's now changed to：
[i]Deal 3/5/7/9 damage to target when they are attacked, stackable, decay[/i]

2. DOT's damage are general not immediate, I hope these runes can somewhat reduce those issues:

Weapon Runes:
[b]Sever: [/b] Deal 50/65/80/100% of target's {Wound} as damage to a unit around it, and to the target if none exists.

Elemental Runes:
[b]Expand: [/b] Deal 50% of target's Posion as earth damage to 2/2/3/3 unit(s) around it, and to the target if none exists.
[b]Broaden: [/b] Deal 25/35/45/60% of target's Frostbite as ice damage to all other units in its row, and to the target if none exists.
[b]Rive: [/b] Deal 25/35/45/60% of target's Rend as dark damage to all other units in its column, and to the target if none exists.
[b]Outspread: [/b] Deal 50/65/80/100% of target's Burn as fire damage to a unit around it, and to the target if none exists.

Also adding two more runes for the block mechanic:
Weapon:
[b]Divert: [/b] Deal 25/35/45/60% of target's Block as damage to a unit around it, and to the target if none exists.

Elemental:
[b]Radiant: [/b] Deal 25/35/45/60% of your Block as light damage to a random enemy within range

These are all the changes in this update, since I'm making all these changes in a very short notice, there are bond to be bugs that I didn't expect, I'll fix them asap whenever they show up. And a lot of the changes (and runes) will make the game arguably easier, I'll make balance changes if necessary.
